children: Credit spreads on euro-denominated bonds are likely to stay steady into the end of 2026, Societe Generale's Juan Valencia says in a note. Euro credit spreads widened in September and October as rising sovereign bond yields, AI concerns, and geopolitical uncertainty led to reduced appetite for risk. "We suspect that we've seen the worst of the damage for now, unless the war in the Middle East deteriorates sharply again," Valencia says. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
